quests.title: Serialized second Donkey letter achievement checkpoint

storySteps.title: Receive Donkey's second letter and component pile from the contraband box
Read Donkey's second letter and open the battle-supply requests
Trade one gold-quality pumpkin for Clotho's enchantment offer
Pay Clotho 50 money and receive the magic pumpkin
Deposit the magic pumpkin in Donkey's contraband box
Let Donkey collect the magic pumpkin and advance the D10 supply convergence
Give Krezvold two component piles and commission Donkey's battle supplies
Pay Krezvold 50 money and wait until midnight for the battle supplies
Collect the unicorn horn and battle horseshoes from Krezvold
Deposit the battle horseshoes and unicorn horn in Donkey's contraband box
Let Donkey collect the battle supplies
Converge both Donkey supply collections and schedule the D10 event handoff
